messages:
Asha Rao: Quick handoff — NeonWave (Enterprise) closed yesterday. Passing to CS for onboarding and to Eng for private/VPC + SSO work.

Asha Rao: Contract highlights: 12-month committed term, Dedicated GPU pool required, VPC peering + SAML SSO.

Asha Rao: Key dates: SSO live by 2024-04-30, pilot traffic target 2024-05-15, GA 2024-06-01.

Asha Rao: Quick summary:
```
account: NeonWave (enterprise)
contact: Eleanor Kim <eleanor@neonwave.com>
peak expected qps: ~350 (burst), avg ~80
latency SLO: P95 <150ms
requirements: Dedicated pool, VPC peering, SAML (AzureAD)
contract: 12mo commit, renewal aligned with GA + 3 months of measurement
```

Sarah Li: Thanks Asha, assigning CS lead — I'll take it.
Sarah Li: Pre-kickoff I need: IdP metadata, primary technical contact at NeonWave, and any compliance docs. Can someone open an eng ticket for the private deploy sizing and SSO work?

Marco Diaz: @eng-oncall-bot can you create a ticket? For sizing we'll need model family, max seq len, prompt/response token estimates, and concurrency pattern.

Priya Shah: I'll own collecting model/payload details from NeonWave and run an initial perf estimate. I can also draft the enablement runbook.

Asha Rao: Eleanor prefers a single POC model (intent: smaller gen model to validate infra). I'll intro Eleanor to Priya and Sarah after this thread.

eng-oncall-bot: Created ticket ENG-7890: "NeonWave private deploy + SSO". Owners: eng-runtime team. Priority: high. Link: https://internal/ENG-7890

Sarah Li: Owners & immediate actions (assigning here):
- Prework (Asha) — share IdP metadata + technical contact + network allowlist — due 2024-04-05
- CS Kickoff (Sarah) — schedule + agenda + invite — target 2024-04-08
- SSO config & VPC peering (ENG-7890: Marco/Priya/eng-runtime) — initial config complete by 2024-04-30
- Dedicated sizing (Marco) — run perf estimate / perf env by 2024-04-12
- Runbook & enablement (Priya) — CS docs + runbook for support handoff by 2024-05-10
- Support playbook (CS -> Support) — create support playbook and triage guide by 2024-05-20

Asha Rao: Intro email sent to Eleanor and cc'd Sarah + Priya. Eleanor is the security lead too; expect network/infra approvals might take ~2 weeks.

Marco Diaz: I'll provision a small test pool and schedule a load test. Need sample payloads + typical token lengths. Priya, can you add those to ENG-7890?

Priya Shah: Yes — I'll request sample payloads and IdP metadata from Eleanor in my intro email today. I'll also add a post-kickoff feedback survey template and a checklist for the CS enablement session.

Sarah Li: :thumbsup: I'll add an entry in the customer-success tracker and make a short checklist for the kickoff. Blocking risk: network approvals from the customer's security team; we should flag to sales if that slips past 4/12.

Asha Rao: Renewal risk: low given commit, but timeline risk is medium because SSO/VPC could delay pilot -> GA. Recommend weekly sync until SSO is verified.

Marco Diaz: Agreed. I'll populate ENG-7890 with perf matrix and timeline.

Sarah Li: Next steps: 1) I will schedule kickoff and post agenda in this thread. 2) Priya to collect IdP metadata + sample payloads and attach to ENG-7890. 3) Marco to post initial sizing PR in ENG-7890. I'll update thread when invites are out.

Asha Rao: Thank you — ping me if any contract clarifications needed.

Priya Shah: Will update here after I get IdP metadata.

eng-oncall-bot: ENG-7890 updated with initial owner assignments and priority tags.

Sarah Li: Closing loop for now — will reopen thread with kickoff invite.
